snippet.title: LOP: Whitefall - Reveal Trailer | A Destruction-Driven Metroidvania
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4360240/LOP_Whitefall/

LOP:Whitefall is a 2D action game redefined through Extreme Destruction. Every impact is physical. Enemies aren’t health bars—destroy them outright, or dismantle them until they can’t fight back. You’ll explore a world fallen silent, navigating its weathered ruins sealed in ice to uncover the secrets it buried.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/szCN47pBut
